name: Tsuruga Fukurouta
source:
The owner of Tsurunoya. A humble and courteous old man.

He is a short man standing 4'4" (~135 cm). He always has a smile on his face and is a gentleman through and through. A man with an amiable personality.

He and Kuroji saved Yozuru, Kosagi and Uzura from being trafficked. He adopted them and are under his care. He is beloved by his adopted daughters and he loves them dearly.
